# Vendors LeadForge pulls

Do not reimplement these. Install them.

| Name | Repo | Install |
|---|---|---|
| Agent Reach | https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach | `pip install agent-reach` or `npm install -g agent-reach` |
| Scrapling | https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling | `pip install scrapling && scrapling install` |

Pins are in `manifest.json`. `src/vendors.py` reads that file.
